answer_1.quote: The goal of the system is conversing naturally with humans on open-ended topics while keeping conditions of given role.

answer_2.quote: We report Distinct-1/2 as automatic metrics and also measure Hits@1/K on the validation set. We also compute SSA (sensibleness and specificity) and use Perplexity (PPL) for unanswerable‑context prediction.

answer_4.quote: We ask the crowd workers to rate on a scale of 1 to 5 whether the generated dialogue satisfies several conditions ... The crowd workers chat 1:1 with a chatbot as users and correct the inappropriate responses.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators score dimensions such as Fluency, Coherence, Situation, Persona, Style, Safety, and also assess Sensibleness and Specificity (SSA).
